subject: Difference between lavPredict output and predicted latent variables using factor scores

messages.author: 5a2f8b4089c81b75
messages.subject: Difference between lavPredict output and predicted latent variables using factor scores
parts:
Hi All,

I would like to obtain estimates/predictions of the latent variables from a CFA model fit.

However, the lavPredict output (e.g., lv_B below) differs from those obtained using the estimated factor scores and the manifest items (e.g., lv_B_fsm_hat).

Furthermore, the ''regression'' factor scores (i.e., lv_r_fsm) also differ from those calculated using the parameter estimates from cfa (e.g., lv_r_fs).

I don't think it's a bug, but a misunderstanding of what lavPredict does. Any suggestions on how to clarify this would be much appreciated. Thanks!

--------------------------------------------
rm(list=ls())
library("lavaan")
# single-factor model
HS.model <- '
visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
'
fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939)


# estimated latent factor using either approach
lv_B <- lavPredict(fit, method="Bartlett", type="lv", fsm=TRUE)
lv_r <- lavPredict(fit, method="regression", type="lv", fsm=TRUE)


# compare to estimates using factor scores from lavPredict
mani_items <- as.matrix(HolzingerSwineford1939[, c("x1","x2","x3")])
lv_B_fsm <- attr(lv_B,"fsm")[[1]]
lv_r_fsm <- attr(lv_r,"fsm")[[1]]
lv_B_fsm_hat <- data.frame("visual"=mani_items %*% t(lv_B_fsm))
lv_r_fsm_hat <- data.frame("visual"=mani_items %*% t(lv_r_fsm))


head(lv_B)
head(lv_B_fsm_hat)
plot(x=lv_B[,1], y=lv_B_fsm_hat[,1]); abline(a=0,b=1)
head(lv_r)
head(lv_r_fsm_hat)
plot(x=lv_r[,1], y=lv_r_fsm_hat[,1]); abline(a=0,b=1)


# compare factor scores (from lavPredict) to calculations using MLE (from cfa)
cov_err <- fitted(fit)$cov
alpha <- as.numeric(c(1,coef(fit)[grepl("=~",names(coef(fit)))]))
sigma2 <- coef(fit)["visual~~visual"]


## Bartlett
aT_Oinv <- t(alpha) %*% solve(cov_err)
aT_Oinv_a <- (aT_Oinv %*% alpha)[1,1]
lv_B_fs <- solve(aT_Oinv_a) %*% aT_Oinv
rbind(lv_B_fsm,lv_B_fs) #equal


## regression
w <- 1/(1+sigma2*aT_Oinv_a)
lv_r_fs <- w*sigma2*aT_Oinv
rbind(lv_r_fsm,lv_r_fs) #unequal?

messages.subject: Re: Difference between lavPredict output and predicted latent variables using factor scores
parts:
Sharing my answers in response to the questions:

1) lavPredict uses centered manifest items.

---------------------------------------------------------------
## centered manifest items
lv_B_fsm_hat_center <- data.frame(
  "visual"=scale(mani_items,center=TRUE,scale=FALSE) %*% t(lv_B_fsm))
lv_r_fsm_hat_center <- data.frame(
  "visual"=scale(mani_items,center=TRUE,scale=FALSE) %*% t(lv_r_fsm))

head(cbind(lv_B,lv_B_fsm_hat_center))
max(abs(lv_B-lv_B_fsm_hat_center[,1]))
head(cbind(lv_r,lv_r_fsm_hat_center))
max(abs(lv_r-lv_r_fsm_hat_center[,1]))
---------------------------------------------------------------

2) The factor scores were incorrectly calculated - the correct calculations are below.

---------------------------------------------------------------
sigma <- fitted(fit)$cov
parest <- lavInspect(fit,what="est")
lambda <- parest$lambda
theta <- parest$theta
psi <- parest$psi

## Bartlett
lv_B_fs <- solve(t(lambda) %*% solve(sigma) %*% lambda)[1,1] * 
  (t(lambda) %*% solve(sigma))
rbind(lv_B_fsm,lv_B_fs) #equal

## regression
lv_r_fs <- t(psi) %*% (t(lambda) %*% solve(sigma))
rbind(lv_r_fsm,lv_r_fs) #equal
---------------------------------------------------------------
